title: Usage is easier to inspect
summary:
Usage exports, model-restricted keys, and an apps refresh led the day; Seedance finally listened to the requested aspect ratio.

Added `/api/usage` with JSON and CSV output, timestamp-based pagination, and a dashboard CSV download. The dashboard also shows recent Pollen spend beside the balance, while balance checks account for that spend before allowing more requests. Pricing tooltips now distinguish flat per-image costs from token-based pricing.

Keys can now be restricted to selected text, image, and video models. Enter has a model selector for keys, and generation requests check permissions after resolving model aliases. Keys without restrictions retain access to all models.

Seedance Pro now passes `aspectRatio` through to video generation instead of ignoring it. Requests without a ratio default to 16:9.

daily.title: Export your usage
daily.text: Inspect usage through `/api/usage` as JSON or CSV, with timestamp-based pagination for longer histories.

daily.title: Download usage from Enter
daily.text: Download your usage records as a CSV from the dashboard.

daily.title: Choose models per key
daily.text: Restrict an API key to the text, image, and video models you select. Requests for other models return a 403. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Another place to explore
daily.text: A separate frontend was added with a generation playground, model discovery, API documentation, an app directory, and a theme editor.

daily.title: Leave an app idea
daily.text: The reorganized community apps collection includes a place to propose ideas for other people to build, alongside clearer app submission guidance.
